description_en: Releases a CIDR allocation from an IP Address Management (IPAM) address pool. Supported allocation types include virtual private cloud (VPC) and custom allocation
description_zh: 释放IPAM地址池的CIDR分配，当前支持的类型包括专有网络、自定义分配
kebab_example: aliyun vpcipam delete-ipam-pool-allocation --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --ipam-pool-allocation-id ipam-alloc-c4vhvr3b22mmc60000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DeleteIpamPoolAllocation

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the region where the CIDR block allocation that you want to release is located.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html operation to obtain the region ID
parameters.help_zh:
要释放的CIDR分配所在的地域ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html接口获取地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the CIDR block allocation that you want to release
parameters.name: ipam_pool_allocation_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform a dry run. Valid values:

true: performs a dry run. The system checks the required parameters, request format, and service limits. The CIDR block allocation is not released. If the check fails, an error message is returned. If the check succeeds, the \`DryRunOperation\` error code is returned.

false (default): sends a normal request. If the request passes the check, a 2xx HTTP status code is returned and the CIDR block allocation is released
parameters.help_zh:
是否只预检此次请求。取值：

true：发送检查请求，不会释放IPAM地址池的CIDR分配。检查项包括是否填写了必需参数、请求格式、业务限制。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误。如果检查通过，则返回错误码DryRunOperation。
false（默认值）：发送正常请求，通过检查后返回HTTP 2xx状态码并直接释放CIDR分配
parameters.name: dry_run

parameters.help_en:
Ensures idempotency. Provide a unique ASCII token generated by your client. A new token is provided for each distinct request.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system uses the RequestId as the ClientToken. The RequestId is unique for each request
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId不一样
parameters.name: client_token
